mapper.select: SELECT /* selectMasterCmClSalesTaxsheetRemarkUploadList */ X.DOC_NAME, X.TARGET, X.KEY_1, X.KEY_2, X.KEY_3, X.KEY_4, X.KEY_5, X.KEY_6, X.KEY_7, X.KEY_8, X.KEY_9, X.KEY_10, X.KEY_11, X.KEY_12, X.SUPP_PRICE AS AR_SUPP_PRICE, X.TAX_PRICE AS AR_TAX_PRICE, X.BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK, X.CONFIRM_ERR_CHK, X.USER_ERR_CHK, X.TOT_SUPP_PRICE_ERR_CHK, X.TOT_TAX_PRICE_ERR_CHK, CASE WHEN X.USER_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 발행자 미일치' WHEN X.BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 발행' WHEN X.CONFIRM_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '매출세금계산서 확정' WHEN X.TOT_SUPP_PRICE_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '공급가액 미일치' WHEN X.TOT_TAX_PRICE_ERR_CHK = 'Y' THEN '세액 미일치' ELSE '정상' END AS STATUS FROM ( SELECT A.DOC_NAME, A.TARGET, A.KEY_1, A.KEY_2, A.KEY_3, A.KEY_4, A.KEY_5, A.KEY_6, A.KEY_7, A.KEY_8, A.KEY_9, A.KEY_10, A.KEY_11, A.KEY_12, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN WHERE SEQ_ID = A.TARGET), 0, 'N', 'Y') AS BILL_SEND_ERR_CHK, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = A.TARGET AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y'), 0, 'N', 'Y') AS CONFIRM_ERR_CHK, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = A.TARGET AND ADD_USER_ID = A.KEY_9), 0, 'Y', 'N') AS USER_ERR_CHK, B.SUPP_PRICE, B.TAX_PRICE, DECODE((SELECT DISTINCT TOT_SUPP_PRICE FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = B.TARGET), B.SUPP_PRICE, 'N', 'Y') AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE_ERR_CHK, DECODE((SELECT DISTINCT TOT_TAX_PRICE FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = B.TARGET), B.TAX_PRICE, 'N', 'Y') AS TOT_TAX_PRICE_ERR_CHK FROM BNTTRXL A, ( SELECT TARGET, SUM(KEY_6) AS SUPP_PRICE, SUM(KEY_7) AS TAX_PRICE FROM BNTTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'AR_REMARK' AND KEY_9 = #{st_user_id} GROUP BY TARGET ) B WHERE 1=1 AND A.DOC_NAME = 'AR_REMARK' AND A.KEY_9 = #{st_user_id} AND A.TARGET = B.TARGET ) X ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(KEY_12)
mapper.update: /*setBnttrxlUploadReg*/ INSERT INTO BNTTRXL ( DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, KEY_11, KEY_12, KEY_13, KEY_14, KEY_15 ) VALUES( #{DOC_NAME}, #{TARGET}, (SELECT LPAD(NVL(MAX(KEY_1), 0)+1, 6, 0) FROM BNTTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = #{DOC_NAME} AND TARGET = #{TARGET} AND KEY_9 = #{ST_USER_ID}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_2}), '', ' ', #{KEY_2}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_3}), '', ' ', #{KEY_3}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_4}), '', ' ', #{KEY_4}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_5}), '', ' ', #{KEY_5}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_6}), '', ' ', #{KEY_6}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_7}), '', ' ', #{KEY_7}), DECODE(TRIM(#{KEY_8}), '', ' ', #{KEY_8}), #{ST_USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), (SELECT TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(KEY_1), 0))+1 FROM BNTTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = #{DOC_NAME} AND KEY_9 = #{ST_USER_ID}), ' ', ' ', ' ' )
